name: comp-512
title: Date Range Popover Picker
description: A form field labelled Date range picker: an outlined button showing Pick a date range and a small calendar glyph. Opening it reveals a month calendar where two clicks shade a span and rewrite the button text.
use: A form needs a compact date range field that stays collapsed until someone opens it.
avoid: Only one month shows at a time and a long range label can be truncated inside a narrow field.
a11y: The trigger has a linked label and a visible focus outline and days are buttons, but the range is only read as plain button text. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a full-width dark outlined button that holds grey placeholder text on the left and a calendar icon on the right. Below, a floating rounded panel shows a month with weekday initials, day numbers, and a grey band with white circular ends for the range.
behaves: Pressing the button drops the calendar open beneath it. A first click sets the start, a second sets the end and the button text becomes something like Nov 07, 2026 - Nov 18, 2026; the panel stays open until dismissed.
customise: The label, placeholder and caption are written in the file; button width, popover alignment and date format are also fixed in the source.
weight: light: A button and one month calendar that only renders while the popover is open.
